mapper.sql: command_key AS commandKey,command_hash AS commandHash,buyer_member_id AS buyerMemberId,request_id AS requestId,core_request_id AS coreRequestId,license_id AS licenseId,module_id AS moduleId,version_id AS versionId,content_hash AS contentHash,terms_hash AS termsHash,target_draft_id AS targetDraftId,target_revision AS targetRevision,business_type AS businessType,target_payload_hash AS targetPayloadHash,planning_region AS planningRegion,commercial_use AS commercialUse,offer_version AS offerVersion,requested_until AS requestedUntil,created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM w18_paid_install_command WHERE buyer_member_id=#{actor} AND license_id=#{license} AND command_key < #{before} ORDER BY command_key DESC LIMIT 51
SELECT FROM w18_paid_install_command WHERE command_key=#{key} AND buyer_member_id=#{actor}
SELECT FROM w18_paid_install_command WHERE command_key=#{key} AND buyer_member_id=#{actor} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,owner_member_id AS ownerMemberId,business_type AS businessType,status,version,payload_hash AS payloadHash FROM content_draft WHERE owner_member_id=#{actor} AND status='DRAFT' AND business_type IN ('TOPIC','ACTIVITY') AND id < #{before} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 51

SELECT r.state,r.license_id AS licenseId,r.module_id AS moduleId,r.version_id AS versionId,r.content_hash AS contentHash, r.terms_hash AS termsHash,r.offer_version AS offerVersion,r.draft_id AS targetDraftId,r.draft_revision AS targetRevision, r.actor_id AS actorId,r.expires_at AS expiresAt,d.id AS ownedDraftId,d.installed_at AS installedAt,u.owned_draft_id AS usageDraftId,u.committed_at AS committedAt FROM w18_module_install_reservation r LEFT JOIN w18_module_owned_draft d ON d.reservation_key=r.reservation_key AND d.buyer_kind=r.buyer_kind AND d.buyer_id=r.buyer_id AND d.target_draft_id=r.draft_id AND d.target_revision=r.draft_revision LEFT JOIN w18_module_install_usage u ON u.reservation_key=r.reservation_key AND u.owned_draft_id=d.id WHERE r.buyer_kind='INDIVIDUAL' AND r.buyer_id=#{actor} AND r.request_id=#{request} LIMIT 2
